feature_inventory.evidence: Analytic GPU tests and 72 original/port PBR frame comparisons

feature_inventory.evidence: Imported DXT5 packing, normal scale and 2D/array/3D tests

Original normal-map and parallax handedness differ and are preserved separately. Supply valid tangents; see LowCostLightingParity.md.

feature_inventory.evidence: 1,008 nonblack-ambient/original image comparisons plus 12 focused GPU tests and eight spatial LPPV cases

The scriptless fallback recovers renderer SH DC, while URP supplies global ambient-probe DC separately. Local/custom probes can therefore differ from the global fallback; match probe inputs or enable reflection maps. See AmbientLighting.md and the repository AmbientLightingParity.md report.

feature_inventory.evidence: 19 camera-compositor and 19 shader-only visibility/control cases, plus per-eye texture sampling
feature_inventory.reason_or_fallback: The shader automatically uses a named GrabPass when no supported camera compositor is active. VRChat avatars need no custom component. An enabled ScreenSpaceDistortion component retains the ordinary mono camera-wide compositor.

feature_inventory.evidence: Positive/negative/vertical/off-center tests; 256 randomized original/port cases across two editors, two color spaces and two anisotropy settings (all pass)
feature_inventory.reason_or_fallback: The camera compositor accumulates signed offsets in RGHalf (ARGBHalf fallback). Forced anisotropy uses an explicit 8x sampler, the nearest supported inline value to original forced 9x. Other quality settings retain ordinary sampling. Raster/depth rounding and 8x/9x filtering can still differ; Disable is a tested explicit quality option when forced filtering is unwanted. No project quality setting or material is rewritten. The shader-only path captures background once per camera using a named GrabPass and distorts per surface; overlapping nonzero offsets are not accumulated across objects, and the extra scene copy has a GPU cost. Zero-offset surfaces discard, preserving distortion underneath without another screen copy (ordinary and reflected-camera regressions). Uniform-zero strength with unused Custom Data coordinates rejects geometry before rasterization; active-surface overhead and invisible-layer savings were measured on D3D11.

limitations: Exact is the matrix's scoped classification, not a proof for every input or hardware configuration.
Feature rows and declaration rows are different units and must not be averaged.
Image pass rates are case counts under fixed tolerances, not a percentage of visual similarity.
Pixel-identical refers to stored RGB capture metrics, not internal HDR buffers, alpha or unobserved pixels/times.
Historical cohorts are not reruns of every case on 0.1.6 and are not independent samples of all use.
No sampling distribution was defined; no universal confidence interval is justified.
All input values, textures, scene topologies, call sequences, GPU/world/XR conditions remain unenumerated.
